spans.s: ḍambhā, Mvy 〔6102〕 = Tib. ḥphaṅ-mduṅ (thuṅ), a sling-hook or spear head to which a string is tied and … (which) is flung at a fish or bird (Das, who gives Skt. śakti as equivalent).
(ḍāmarika, once in late Skt. = caura, Schmidt, Nachträge; AMg. ˚ria; man of violence, ruffian: ˚kānāṃ manuṣyaghātakānāṃ Gv 〔157.3〕 (prose).)
